#bot.Expression.clear
So that’s what she came up with, huh. She will message them in the bathroom.
I pressured her too hard about it and now she feels the need to hide it from us. I feel awful about it, even if my intentions were right…
Bot: Will Annalie be ok? It’s taking her awfully long. It might be constipation. In rare cases they can even cause death. Should I perform an examination?
You: I don’t think that will be needed…
Bot: Oh, here she comes.
